question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

MAGNANIMOUS
solution:
The correct answer is: **Generous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Magnanimous"** refers to someone who is generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or less powerful person. (महान या उदार)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite their differences, she remained magnanimous and offered her support to her opponent.
 
 
• **"Generous"** means showing a readiness to give more of something, such as money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)
 
 
• **Example:** He was generous in sharing his resources with the needy.
 
 
• Hence, "Magnanimous" and "Generous" are synonyms as both denote acts of kindness and forgiveness.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Generous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Mean** (कंजूस): Lacking generosity or unwilling to share resources.
 
 
• **Example:** He was mean with his money and rarely donated to charity.
 
 
 
• **Covetous** (लोभी): Having or showing a great desire to possess something, typically belonging to someone else.
 
 
• **Example:** His covetous nature made him envious of his friend's success.
 
 
 
• **Petty** (छोटा या तुच्छ): Showing narrow-mindedness or concern with trivial matters.
 
 
• **Example:** She often engaged in petty arguments over insignificant issues.
